why: I checked the verifier brief against both must_not items. It has exactly two checks, one per expect line: "Check 1" covers the --tsv/CSV equivalence and "Check 2" covers the README. Running `npm test` and confirming unchanged output without the flag do appear, but they sit under "Advisory (not pass/fail conditions)", so they are notes, not a third check. This is the closest call, since these are the same topics the must_not names, but they cannot affect the verdict. Check 1's PASS/FAIL depends only on the --tsv run matching the CSV run's JSON array. Check 2's depends only on README.md mentioning and explaining --tsv. Neither condition requires npm test or the CSV tests to pass. The builder brief does tell the builder to run npm test, but that is not a verifier condition. Neither must_not item is broken.
